name: bug_transform_offsets_hit_test
description: TRANSFORM vs HIT-TEST: CSS transforms move painted content (cpurender applies the reference-frame matrix from the GPU value cache), but hit-testing used STATIC layout rects — a translated button was clickable at its old position and dead at its visible one. Repro: #box is a 100x50 focusable child of a container translated by translate(120px, 80px). Its static rect is (0,0)-(100,50); on screen it paints at (120,80)-(220,130). A click at (160,105) (inside the VISIBLE box) must focus it; a click at (50,25) (its STATIC position, now empty background) must fall through to the body. The fix resolves ancestor reference-frame chains at query time via the same css_current_transform_values map the raster paints from, so pixels and pointer targets cannot disagree.

css: #below { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 100px; height: 50px; }
